test_suite.command: npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
test_suite.notes: vitest: 351 files passed / 11 skipped; 1555 tests passed, 60 skipped. Playwright (chromium + webkit): 417 passed, 19 skipped, 0 failed (1.2m). Exit 0.

end_to_end.command: npm run build && npm run preview; New game -> Start game; queueMicrotask(() => { throw new Error('x') }) during hand 1; Return Home; Back
end_to_end.expected: Error screen; Return Home shows Home with heading focused and Resume session 'Cash · 6 players · $4/$8 · 0 hands · paused'; one browser Back leaves the app. After 3 completed hands, error then Return Home shows '3 hands · paused' and one Back leaves the app.
end_to_end.actual: Driven in the preview build in chromium and webkit: a real uncaught error (no fault hook) in hand 1 showed the error screen with focus on its heading and no Table; Return Home focused the TLH Trainer heading, data-paused='shown', subtitle exactly '... 0 hands · paused', history.state.tlhTable undefined. Repeated twice (Resume, error again, Return Home) with the same result. After Resume, Back returns to Home and one more Back reaches about:blank. Judge scenario with 3 completed hands then an illegal-bot fault in hand 4: '3 hands · paused', 3 stored records, tlhTable cleared, one Back -> about:blank.

integrity.notes: doit.py test-integrity exit 0 with no output. The diff against base 3b6f33a touches only src/ui/AppRoot.tsx (removes generation state, its comment and key prop; #returnHome now setState({error:false, returned:true})), docs/ui/navigation.md (+4 lines), and the new e2e file. No locked test edited, no hard-coded or special-cased product logic, no mocks of the unit under test. Mutation checks in a throwaway worktree: (a) replacing history.back() in #returnHome with a no-op makes both projects' SPEC-01 test fail at the tlhTable assertion; (b) making the paused-session lookup skip 0-hand records makes both projects' SPEC-02 test fail at data-paused. So the new tests can fail and do pin the behaviour.

items.evidence: Spec test 'Return Home after an error in hand 1 steps off the Table history entry so one Back leaves the app' passes in chromium and webkit. It asserts heading focus, no Table region, tlhTable polls undefined, goBack -> about:blank, and it fails when history.back() is removed (mutation). Holdout: the same history behaviour with the reject-bot and worker-error faults in hand 1, after 3 completed hands, and after a real uncaught error repeated twice. All pass in both projects.

Spec test 'an error in hand 1 leaves a 0-hand paused session that Home offers for Resume' passes in both projects. It asserts data-paused='shown', the exact subtitle, storedRecords [], one session with handsPlayed 0 and no endedAt, and Resume -> 'Hand #1'. It fails when 0-hand sessions are hidden (mutation). Holdout: the stored session is unchanged across error and Return Home; after Resume the six seat names match the pre-error line-up and every stack is $160; reject-bot and worker-error faults also give '0 hands · paused'. All pass.

The verification command ran: grep finds no generation/key= in AppRoot.tsx, typecheck and build pass, and the locked e2e/error-recovery.spec.ts plus the new file give 14 passed. Holdout: two error -> Return Home cycles in one page each give a fresh Home with the heading focused and the correct Resume state, so the remount still works without the key.

summary: All 3 SPEC items PASS. Full suite is green (vitest 1555 passed, Playwright 417 passed, 0 failed). End to end PASS in the preview build in chromium and webkit. Integrity PASS, and both new tests fail under mutation. No findings.
